context: Saito explains a morning appointment to a patient.
purpose: WIDENED SCENARIO: clinic scheduling; vocabulary (先ほど/時刻/とおり/午前/前回) in natural home.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 次の予約は、いつでしょうか?
lines.style: polite office woman voice, soft warm clarity throughout

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 前回どおり、午前がよろしいですね。
lines.en: As last time, morning is good.
lines.style: calm doctor voice, soft warm reassuring measured clarity throughout

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 時刻は、九時で大丈夫ですか?
lines.style: attentive office woman voice, soft warm clarity throughout

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 先ほど確認したとおり、九時で取れます。
lines.en: As I checked just now, nine is available.
lines.style: clear doctor voice, soft warm measured clarity throughout

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 前回の検査の結果も、聞けますか?
lines.en: Can I hear last time's test results too?
lines.style: curious office woman voice, soft warm clarity throughout

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: ええ、前回の結果も、その時刻にお伝えします。
lines.en: Yes, I'll share last time's results at that time.
lines.style: gentle doctor voice, soft warm reassuring clarity throughout

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 午前なら、仕事の前に来られます。
lines.en: If it's morning, I can come before work.
lines.style: relieved office woman voice, soft warm clarity throughout

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: では、そのとおり予約しておきますね。
lines.style: warm doctor voice, soft warm caring closing clarity throughout
